# Composio app research: 100 apps

> Auth, self-serve vs gated, API surface, MCP, buildability verdict and evidence URLs for 100 apps, verified with a browser audit (85.8% -> 93.3% on a 20-app sample; post-loop holdout 48/48).

- [Dataset (JSON)](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/docs/results.json): one object per app, schema in spec/rubric.md
- [Dataset (CSV)](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/docs/results.csv)
- [Rubric](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/spec/rubric.md)
- [Change log](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/data/changelog.jsonl): every correction with reason and source
- [Gold labels](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/data/gold_sample.json), [holdout](https://github.com/piyushsamdariya31/composio-app-research/blob/main/data/gold_holdout_b.json)

## Headline patterns
- 71/100 can be built as a toolkit today: 22 more are buildable once a review, paid plan or key request is cleared. Only 7 are blocked by a partnership or a missing public API.
- OAuth2 is the most common primary auth, but keys are everywhere: OAuth2 is the best primary method for 50 apps; a static API key or token for 45. 74 apps offer a key or token and 67 offer OAuth2. 45 offer both, so toolkits need first-class key support, not just OAuth.
- 72/100 give developers credentials without asking anyone: Developer, Infra and Data platforms and Productivity and Project Management are 10/10 self-serve. The gated categories: Marketing, Ads, Email and Social 5/10; Ecommerce 5/10; AI, Research and Media-native 5/10; Finance and Fintech 5/10. Ads platforms gate on app review, fintech on account approval or partnership, AI-native apps on paid plans.
- 11 + 11 app review and paid plans tie as the top blocker: Partnership gates are rarer (6) and sit with enterprise and fintech apps: DealCloud, Pylon, Gladly, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Paygent Connect, PitchBook.
- 9 easy wins: ready now and not yet a full Composio toolkit: LiveAgent, Vonage, systeme.io, WooCommerce, Magento (Adobe Commerce), Netlify, Binance, iPayX, Reducto. Another 11 apps missing from Composio need outreach or a sponsored account.
- 60 apps have an official MCP that acts on account data: But "official MCP" can mean docs search: Twilio, Mailchimp and Vonage ship MCP servers that only search their documentation, and Slack’s MCP is open only to Marketplace-listed or internal apps.
